t: You're looking at the Michael Rutter Centre for Children and Adolescents, an outpatient service for young people with mental health problems, based at the Maudsley Hospital, an NHS psychiatric hospital. It's named after Sir Michael Rutter, who was the first person appointed professor of child psychiatry in the United Kingdom, and who has been called the father of child psychiatry. The centre treats conditions such as anorexia in children.
